subject: Request: COO sign-off — 72h dunning hold & automation cutover for HelioMed
messages:
From: Paul Santos <paul.santos@heliomed.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
Cc: HelioMed Treasury <treasury@heliomed.com>
Date: Sat, 24 Jul 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Outstanding remittance for INV-11901 — withholding tax impact

Jordan,

Thanks for the call earlier. Quick summary from treasury: HelioMed processed payment for INV-11901 on 2027-07-23 but applied a local withholding of 40% while they verify cross-border VAT reciprocity. They need a clear VAT certificate or our EU entity remittance evidence before they release the remainder.

They've asked us not to run further automated dunning notices while they complete their internal approvals (this should take ~72 hours). Can you confirm you can provide the VAT proof and whether Redwood can pause the automated dunning for HelioMed during that window? If a pause needs leadership sign-off, let me know and I'll escalate internally so treasury doesn't escalate to collections.

Attached: payment_remittance_20270723.pdf (remit stub).

—Paul
Paul Santos
Treasury Manager, HelioMed
paul.santos@heliomed.com
+1 415-555-0192

From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
To: Paul Santos <paul.santos@heliomed.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 24 Jul 2027 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Outstanding remittance for INV-11901 — withholding tax impact

Paul — thanks for the note and the remit stub. We're reviewing on our side.

Kimberly & Marcus — looping you in. Treasury is asking for two things:
- VAT certificate or equivalent proof from Redwood's EU entity to release the retained funds.
- A temporary pause of automated dunning for HelioMed while treasury confirms (they've requested ~72h).

Immediate ask: can Finance produce the VAT evidence quickly (Marcus)? And Collections (Kim) — can we suspend dunning for the account for up to 72 hours without breaking the new automation cutover that goes live next week?

I will hold escalation on my side if we can provide the docs + a short pause.

Thanks,
Jordan Blake
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
jordan_blake@redwood.com
+1 650-555-0124

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 26 Jul 2027 08:41:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Outstanding remittance for INV-11901 — withholding tax impact

Jordan / Marcus — quick internal note.

1) Dunning automation cutover (project "RemitStream") is scheduled for 2027-07-29. During cutover we will flip to the new staged dunning logic which will re-trigger notices based on the new schedule. If HelioMed is left in the system without a manual hold, there's a risk they receive an automated reminder mid-cutover.

2) Recommendation: apply a manual account-level hold now (not a system policy change) and document the hold in the ticket. That allows the cutover to proceed while keeping HelioMed off the cadence. We can then remove the manual hold after we receive VAT evidence or after 72 hours, whichever comes first.

3) Because a manual hold is a leadership exception for high-value accounts, I recommend we request a brief COO sign-off (72h hold — non-financial, operational only). If Markus okays, Collections will enact the hold and mark the account exempt from automated triggers.

I'll prepare the quick comms we send to Treasury once we have the VAT doc. Lauren, can Legal draft the short confirmation language we send that doesn't create payment terms changes?

—Kim
Kimberly Park
Head of Collections, Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwood.com

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 26 Jul 2027 10:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Outstanding remittance for INV-11901 — withholding tax impact

Jordan / Kim — finance perspective: we can produce a scanned VAT certificate for our EU billing entity plus a ledger extract that shows prior reciprocal remittances. I'll attach the draft (vat_certificate_draft.pdf) and the invoice (invoice_11901.pdf) to the ticket.

Operationally I'd prefer to do a split: apply the received 60% to the invoices now and put the 40% on an internal suspense account pending evidence. This reflects actual cash while protecting revenue recognition. We can release suspense to invoice once evidence is delivered — should be straightforward.

Also: I'll open RC-4521 in Jira to record the temporary hold and note the cutover timing so RemitStream SREs are aware of the exception. Link added below.

—Marcus Lin
Director, Revenue Ops & Billing
marcus_lin@redwood.com

From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 27 Jul 2027 09:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Request: COO sign-off for 72h dunning hold + automation cutover rollback plan (HelioMed — INV-11901)

Markus — brief ask and context:

- Account: HelioMed (INV-11901, deal HLMD-2027-11901). Treasury applied a 40% withholding and asked RED not to run dunning while they verify VAT reciprocity.
- Docs: Finance can provide a VAT certificate + invoice copy. Collections recommends a manual account-level hold to avoid automated reminders during the RemitStream cutover on 2027-07-29.
- Proposal: approve a time-limited (72 hour) manual hold and exception so Collections can mark HelioMed as exempt from automation. Marcus proposes applying the 60% received to the invoice and holding 40% in suspense until evidence is received.

If you approve, Collections will: (1) apply manual hold immediately, (2) annotate ticket RC-4521, (3) send neutral confirmation language to HelioMed from Legal (cc'd Lauren), and (4) remove the hold on receipt of VAT proof or after 72 hours. If you prefer, we can also apply a canary rollback plan for RemitStream to ensure no changes are pushed that affect held accounts.

Quick decision requested — treasury is waiting on our confirmation and we want to avoid a formal escalation from their procurement team.

Thanks,
Jordan

From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 27 Jul 2027 16:40:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: COO sign-off for 72h dunning hold + automation cutover rollback plan (HelioMed — INV-11901)

Approved.

Actions:
- Kimberly: implement manual account-level hold immediately and tag RC-4521 with the hold note.
- Marcus: attach the VAT draft & invoice to the ticket and proceed with split posting for cash received.
- Lauren: prepare the neutral confirmation email to send to HelioMed confirming we will pause reminders for 72 hours while they complete treasury verification. Keep language limited to operational hold; do not alter payment terms.
- Jordan: once confirmation goes to HelioMed, add a one-line incumbent note in Salesforce and set follow-up for 72 hours.

If RemitStream SREs need a canary rollback, approve that as necessary — do it with a single toggle to avoid mid-cutover complexity.

—Markus
Markus Klein
Chief Operating Officer, Redwood Inference
